uncertainties: Attribution is CALLER_PREMISE_PLAN, not RUN_RECORD or FROZEN_PLAN: neither DEV/runs/RUN-005/metrics.json nor PROTO-POPU-RELIABILITY-v5-DEV005.json states a premise_id, so premise_verified / status_verified / closure_verified are all false. What makes RUN-005 attributable is that its recorded protocol_sha256 b9b31799... matches the cited plan bytes -- not a premise label on disk. Quoting it as evidence is allowed; calling the premise settled is not.

RUN-005 is DEV_ONLY / EXPLORATORY_CONFIRMATION_NOT_INDEPENDENT: the same 12 subjects were reused in RUN-002/003/004/005, so nothing here is independent confirmation, and the truth proxy is the upper Tactilus layer, not clinical truth.

PROJECT-48-DEFECT-005 (HGB without random_state) degrades RUN-004's numeric precision; only its NEG direction is safe. RUN-005 was seeded and re-ran identically twice, so its numbers are reproducible, but the seed convention post-dates RUN-001-004.

SCIENCE-03C correction: RUN-004's paired M3-M1 CI is 'exact-per-fit' and therefore optimistic (seed jitter not inside it); the -0.059 must not be compared directly with the 0.271 marginal jitter. Conclusion unaffected.

RUN-005 intermediate attempt after AMENDMENT-001 has no artifact (INTERMEDIATE_ATTEMPT_ARTIFACT_ABSENT) and one of four runner executions has no recorded wall clock (NOT_RECORDED); the '123.5 s' cost line undercounts.

The second packet's NOT_YET_RUN is a guard against a mis-cited plan, not evidence that RUN-005 failed to run; reading it as a science verdict would be wrong.
